content.text: I have reviewed every location where a restriction on Client's business could sit. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: Client is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink hereunder, so long as such
input.rationale: No non-compete or field-of-use covenant binds Client anywhere in the Agreement, so the rule sits at our preferred position. Section 2(a) (p0022/p0024) affirmatively confirms Client is not obligated to use the License and is free to acquire, develop or license competing software and services (subject only to TrueLink IP and confidentiality), which is a benefit to us. Section 8 (Client covenants) contains only compliance, non-representation, access-control, IP warranty and anti-spam undertakings (p0049, p0051-p0058) — none restricts our lines of business or products. Two points noted but not flagged: (i) the Section 2(a) licence scope is tied to Client's consumer finance receivables business, which is an ordinary limit on the licensed Interface rather than a covenant restricting our own business; and (ii) Section 8(d) (p0054) cross-refers to an undefined, unattached "Non-Competition Agreement", but there it operates only to limit TrueLink's rights in Credit Data, not to restrict Client — we should still review that side agreement separately for any covenant binding us.

mappings.element: Customer has no non-compete or field-of-use restriction.
